onset: Reported by 28 Sep; thus not an October onset.
continuity: EJU/Radio Fides reports the blockade and family participation continuing into 7 Oct; earlier El Potosí report places it at San Antonio. The EJU pieces credit Radio Fides and are not independent of it.
location: Puente San Antonio / Potosí–Oruro route; exact simultaneous gathering footprints and crowd size unknown.
demand: Wages owed by Andacaba mine/employer; miners asked public ministries to intervene. Whether the demand targets state policy or primarily private employer remains unresolved.
threshold: Unknown. A reported 300 affected workers is not blockade attendance.
ownership_decision: Do not assign as October-onset event; keep onset in September and state-target/threshold unresolved.
followup: Identify the legal employer and public-policy ask, plus an attendance count at a specific contemporaneous blockade point. Do not infer either from the number of workers affected.

onset: October actions include distinct gatherings from 20 Oct onward; later November actions require separate episode ownership decisions.
continuity: Reports show election-result and two-thirds mobilization in late October and early November. Shared topic alone does not prove one episode; each date/site remains separate unless further evidence establishes continuity.
ownership_decision: Do not merge Oct20 Cristo Redentor, Oct27 Avenida Saavedra, Oct28 Plaza 24 de Septiembre, Oct30 distributed blockades, or November actions.
followup: Compare Nov1–7 local evidence for distinct gatherings, demands and attendance. This is a continuity lead, not a claim of one continuous event.
